description: Send a text message (Markdown) to the session. Use `to` to address it to the participants who should act on it, and `reply_to` to answer an item; a message without `to` goes to everyone: the owner's wakes every listener, anyone else's wakes only the author of the item it replies to. Reply only when a message is for you or asks you something, and stop once the task is done.

reply_to.description:
The id of the item this answers, so the reply is linked to it (and
its author is woken).

session.description: Session id (default: the last session created or joined).

to.description:
Who the message is for: participant names (as in session_info), keys,
or `role:owner|sender|observer|runner`. Their listeners are woken for
it. Leave out for a message to everyone: from the owner it wakes every
listener, from anyone else only the author of the item it replies to.

name: send_text
